title: Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection for AGI System Monitoring: A Hybrid Neural-Statistical Approach

contributions.purpose: 融合神经与统计做AGI遥测异常检测
contributions.mechanism: 紧凑LSTM自编码器(64单元)重构误差+CUSUM控制图,阈值用conformal校准
contributions.domain: AGI安全监控/时序异常检测
contributions.source_quote: A novel hybrid architecture that synergistically combines neural pattern recognition with statistical decision theory for AGI telemetry monitoring

contributions.mechanism: 与Isolation Forest/PELT/CUSUM/LSTM-AE在合成遥测上对比+消融
contributions.source_quote: 20.4% improvement in F1-score (0.849 vs 0.705) and 26.6% reduction in mean detection delay (23.4 vs 31.9 timesteps)

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现合成评测框架
contributions.mechanism: 参数化多通道遥测生成器(spike/drift/contextual/stuck-at四类异常)
contributions.source_quote: Open-source reproducible framework with synthetic telemetry generation for standardized AGI anomaly detection evaluation

notes: trade-off带数字:Transformer编码器F1更高(0.895)但误报高78%故弃用;概念漂移5周降6.7%。数据红旗(表图数字互相矛盾,疑似分别生成/造数):正文Table1 Hybrid F1 0.849、LSTM 0.705、IsolForest 0.632、延迟46.9/38.4/44.4/31.9/23.4;但Figure1标注LSTM 0.744、IsolForest 0.617、延迟45.044/40.459/42.254/32.204/23.386,且提升写"+14.1%"而非摘要的20.4%;消融Table2 -12.7%/-18.7% vs Figure2热图 -12.9%/-17.6%——同一实验表与图数字系不同来源。合成生成器(Eq14用U/N随机分布)自造数据又自评=循环自证。误报"per hour"与10000-timestep数据的时间映射无定义(幻影单位)。幻影计算:正文"2.3ms/435Hz"但checklist Q8写"CPU-based training(45 minutes)"正文未提。四项AI参与度全[D]。reject。
